---
applyTo: "godot/android-plugin/**,godot/export_presets.cfg,.github/workflows/android-*.yml,fdroid/**"
---
Android Cathedral law: Godot Android plugin v2 + Gradle is the only native WebView extension lane. Package the Vue CMS as app assets and serve it through WebViewAssetLoader. Native WebMessage listeners must be origin-locked to https://appassets.androidplatform.net. Keep file/content URL access disabled. Permit cleartext only for loopback edge development. PR/nightly APKs use ephemeral signing; permanent signing keys belong only in an approval-gated release workflow. Never bypass Samsung Auto Blocker, Android package install consent, or F-Droid signing rules.
